requirements.text: The System shall decode each language native documentation syntax into the universal contract through the language pack codec declaration.
The System shall skip the preamble a profile declares, including shebang lines, before decoding the documentation header.
If the documentation header is not the first content after the declared preamble, then the System shall report the file as missing its documentation header.
When a codec declaration names a field spelling, the System shall decode text matching that spelling into the universal field name.
